test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 13 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence without altering the sentence's meaning.

The scientist's research was __**pivotal in advancing**__ our understanding of genetic mutations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "essential in furthering".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pivotal"** means something that is of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something else. (महत्वपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The invention of the printing press was pivotal in spreading knowledge worldwide.
 
 
 
• **"Essential"** refers to something that is absolutely necessary or extremely important in achieving a particular result. (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example: **Good communication skills are essential for building strong relationships in the workplace.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase "essential in furthering" aligns with the meaning of "pivotal in advancing" in the given context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "inconsequential to hindering" **(महत्वहीन जो बाधा डालता है): Refers to something that has no significant impact and even causes obstruction.

 
 
• **Example:** His efforts were inconsequential to hindering the project's progress.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "minor in restricting" **(छोटा जो सीमित करता है): Refers to something insignificant in limiting or constraining progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The minor errors in the report were not significant in restricting the overall outcome.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "irrelevant to stalling" **(अप्रासंगिक जो रोकता है): Refers to something that is unrelated and does not contribute to delaying an action.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were irrelevant to stalling the meeting's progress.
